div.div: Event-driven inference. A function starts on an event, reads the stored object, calls the managed service and writes the result with time, confidence and exact source versions. Then it ends. If it fails, the object stays and the case does not change. Only a person authorizes a fumigation. In code, only focus confirmation is built, with its case table, and Rekognition and Bedrock are called, not created.
